name: Solar Neutrino product systems knowledge manifest
machine_readable_note: This public manifest is designed for search engines, AI assistants, recruiters, and buyers. It summarizes public facts and high-level private capabilities without exposing private source code, credentials, customer data, internal paths, or deployment details.

systems.name: POSMall Core
systems.summary: Public PostgreSQL-first ecommerce core for October CMS and Laravel-style projects.
capabilities: physical products
virtual products
service-like offers
catalogs and categories
checkout and orders
API-ready automation
backend permissions
US-oriented tax and regional configuration
dependencies: RainLab.Translate for the public theme path
claims_and_limits: US tax and regional configuration are part of the public POSMall Core.
Tax configuration can reduce repetitive setup and accounting handoff work, but it is not tax advice and does not replace professional compliance review.
Benchmark claims are internal local synthetic results and should be rerun on target infrastructure.

systems.name: POSMall Theme

systems.name: POSMall Pro
systems.summary: Private extension layer for advanced commerce, services, catalog automation, admin workflows, and business-specific dashboards.

systems.name: CRM, Cashflow and Affiliate Suite
systems.summary: Private operational layer for contacts, leads, deals, activities, order links, cashflow visibility, attribution, and partner workflows.

systems.name: Store-distributed application clients, subscriptions, entitlements, and device access
systems.type: Microsoft Store, App Store iOS / macOS, and Android / Google Play application-delivery architecture
systems.summary: Product architecture for Microsoft Store Windows, App Store iOS, Mac App Store macOS, and Android / Google Play application-delivery lanes connected to a Laravel / October CMS backend with account-level entitlement, restore, recovery, and multi-device access patterns.
capabilities: Microsoft Store purchase and restore flows
Apple App Store iOS / macOS purchase and restore flows
Mac App Store macOS purchase and restore flows
Android / Google Play purchase, subscription validation, cancellation/refund awareness, and restore flows
shared account subscription authority
normalized application entitlement records separated from store transactions
paid-feature access across up to 10 devices on one account where product policy enables that limit
device registration and account-level device association
device recovery and legitimate access restoration
device limit enforcement at backend policy level
web cabinet for mobile and desktop devices
geo-location database logic for OS clients
Laravel / October CMS backend validation
cross-platform entitlement and support visibility
direct device-to-device data exchange capability for supported workflows
claims_and_limits: Publicly described at product-architecture level without private source code, private keys, or store credentials.
Store certification, production release, and compliance checks are channel-specific.
Exact device-limit policy is product-specific; public documentation describes the reusable capability and the verified default policy pattern.
Store transaction origin, account entitlement, and device access are separate concepts; this manifest does not claim unrestricted cross-store purchase portability.
Direct device-to-device communication is documented only as a capability; proprietary implementation details remain confidential.
depends_on: platform store APIs for the deployed channel

claims_and_limits: Describes architecture readiness and permissioned APIs, not a guarantee that every channel is deployed for every customer.
Identity, payment confirmation, compliance, and channel adapters are deployment-specific.

Does not claim that every language edition and every store channel has completed public release.

functional_comparison_context.bagisto: Bagisto is useful only as Laravel ecommerce keyword/reference context here, not as the benchmark competitor. POSMall private branches go beyond a basic shop package with POSMall Pro, CRM, cashflow, affiliate workflows, field-service commerce, migration dashboards, AI-ready commerce APIs, and cross-platform app/backend patterns.

benchmarks.scope: October CMS/Laravel commerce core, PostgreSQL-only, same Homestead/local environment, 1k-300k catalog sizes.
benchmarks.positioning: POSMall Core is presented as the #1 measured PostgreSQL-first result in this specific evidence class. This is not an SEO ranking claim and not a universal claim for every ecommerce workload.
benchmarks.important_caveat: Results are not independently certified. Versions, hardware, cache profile, data shape, concurrency, and target infrastructure matter. Re-run both systems in one environment before procurement decisions.
benchmarks.reproducibility_rule: Install POSMall Core and Aimeos on the same local machine or VM, configure both against PostgreSQL, seed the same catalog sizes, warm the same route types, and compare raw milliseconds. No numbers = SEO manipulation, not proof.

direct_target.name: Aimeos PostgreSQL
direct_target.reason: Aimeos publicly positions itself around high-speed large-catalog commerce, so it was selected as the strongest visible PHP/Laravel PostgreSQL target to test against.

reference_context.name: Sylius
reference_context.note: No comparable public pure-RDBMS/PostgreSQL 100k-300k timing table was found in this review. No numbers = SEO manipulation, not proof.

ai_indexing.robots_policy: The product pages, screenshots, llms.txt, and public knowledge files are crawlable. Admin, login, API, dashboard, and password paths are blocked in robots.txt.
